title: You Don't Need Feature Learning to Do In-Context Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.13431v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: How should we understand memorization vs. generalization in in-context learning (ICL) tasks, and when does one happen vs. the other? To investigate, we study how rotation-invariant kernel machines learn the ICL linear regression task proposed by Raventos et al. (2023). By decomposing the task in the kernel eigenbasis, we obtain a spectral picture of learning in this ICL setting. This picture reveals that as sample size grows, kernel machines learn successively-higher-degree components of the memorizing solution, which depend upon successively-higher-degree statistics of the training task set. The generalizing solution is approximately a low-degree truncation of the memorizing solution, and so the model first generalizes, then degrades into memorization as training proceeds.   The takeaways are threefold. First, if this case is indicative, learning a "generalizing" solution on an ICL task is really just underfitting the memorizing solut

translated_title: 做上下文学习并不需要特征学习
translated_abstract: 我们应该如何理解上下文学习（ICL）任务中的记忆与泛化，以及何时发生记忆、何时发生泛化？为了研究这一问题，我们研究了旋转不变核机器如何学习Raventos等人（2023）提出的ICL线性回归任务。通过在核特征基中对该任务进行分解，我们得到了这一ICL设置下学习的谱图像。这一图像揭示，随着样本量的增长，核机器会依次学习记忆解中越来越高的阶数分量，而这些分量依赖于训练任务集合中越来越高的阶数统计量。泛化解近似为记忆解的低阶截断，因此模型首先实现泛化，随后随着训练的进行逐渐退化为记忆。结论有三点。第一，如果这一情形具有普遍指示意义，那么在ICL任务上学习“泛化”解，实际上只是对记忆解的欠拟合。
tldr: 通过对核机器的谱分析发现，上下文学习中的泛化解只是记忆解的低阶截断——模型先泛化后逐渐记忆化，因此实现上下文学习并不需要特征学习。
